correctness.rationale: The cutoff K_r is a compact expanding Markov survivor, not the full noncompact system. Interval adjacency A_r has 4^r rows, with 0/1 transitions to the first min(4^ℓ(i)+1,4^r) unit intervals. Integer boundary points can have multiple codings, but only integer periodic point is 0, uniquely in I1; hence periodic itineraries and periodic points are bijective. Lump identical rows by four-adic groups, A_r=UV and VU=C_r, and use tr(A_r^n)=tr(C_r^n), Sylvester determinant and finite Markov entropy. For Perron λ=m+δ, normalize x_r=1; positivity and λ≥m bound x_j≤(3/(2m))x_{j+1} and δ≤1/2. Expanding exact last-three row equations yields δ=1/3−4/(135m)+O(m⁻²) uniformly. Finite first/second-period formulas computed directly as traces.
